_comments: Finance control for bc-aidp-next-golive#443, as a shared view on Order Headers so each row opens the order.

The same rule as the query 'Sales: Orders Invoiced Without Executed Agreement', which adds the deal, contract and invoice-status columns this view cannot carry. A unit test pins the two WHERE rules together.

Listed: orders a WON deal names (DealStatusType.IsWon) that are Confirmed or have a Sent Bill.com invoice, where neither Deal.ContractID nor a contract the deal's close created (CreatingRecordID) has vwContracts.IsAwaitingDocument = 0. A contract type with RequiresExecutedDocument = 0 counts as covered.
IsShared so finance can load it. UserID is the install Owner, as for 'Sales: Pipeline'.
CustomWhereClause is true because the WHERE rule is hand-written SQL; without it MJUserViewEntityExtended rebuilds WhereClause from an empty FilterState on save and the view lists every order.

fields.Name: Sales: Orders Invoiced Without Executed Agreement
fields.Description: Confirmed or invoiced orders from won deals with no contract, or a contract with no executed agreement linked. The query of the same name adds the deal, contract and invoice status.
fields.WhereClause: (Status = 'Confirmed' OR ID IN (SELECT ei.OrderHeaderID FROM [__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwExternalInvoices ei WHERE ei.Status = 'Sent')) AND ID IN (SELECT d.OrderID FROM [__mj_BizAppsSales].vwDeals d INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsSales].DealStatusType st ON st.ID = d.DealStatusTypeID AND st.IsWon = 1 WHERE d.OrderID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsContracts].vwContracts c WHERE c.IsAwaitingDocument = 0 AND (c.ID = d.ContractID OR (d.ContractID IS NULL AND c.CreatingEntity = 'MJ_BizApps_Sales: Deals' AND c.CreatingRecordID = CAST(d.ID AS NVARCHAR(450))))))
